note: Isaiah wave I-6, chapter 37 Editor. Read base: central v5.0.0 (read-only, read with Python, not edited). Contents: 7 modify ops, six appliesTo extensions with rationale addenda (cherubim-ezek, cherem-devote-to-destruction-cross-corpus, shamayim, yeor-nile-egyptian-loanword, yatsar, she-erit-remnant-cross-corpus-theological-keyword) and one rationale-only addendum on malakh-yhwh-messenger, whose appliesTo already lists ISA-37:36 (empty appliesToAdded). No wohChoice or claim_type changed; minor bump. DELIBERATE NON-EXTENSIONS: pleitah-deliverance-escape-remnant-tradition-cross-corpus at 37:31-32 (its wohChoice is the Gen 45:7 'deliverance'; cited, as lexical-cruxes-isaiah-4 cited it at 4:2); harei-ararat at 37:38 (governs 'the mountains of Ararat'). rationaleAppend: isaiah-woh wave I-6 (Isa 37:36): the entry's existing ISA-37:36 site is applied in the line, 'And the messenger of YHWH went out and struck down in the camp of Assyria a hundred and eighty-five thousand'. ASV 'the angel of Jehovah', JPS 1917 'the angel of the LORD', NJPS 'an angel of the LORD' (checked 2026-11-27). The isaiah-woh overlay lexical-cruxes-isaiah-33 had left this verse open; the decision to keep the entry is recorded in overlay lexical-cruxes-isaiah-37. Isaiah renders malʾāḵ 'messenger' at every other site (14:32; 18:2; 33:7; 37:9, 14), so 'messenger' here keeps one English noun through the book, and the verse's own 'messengers' of Sennacherib (37:9, 14) stand beside the messenger of YHWH as the Hebrew has it. 2 Kgs 19:35 has the same phrase (MT, Sefaria, checked) and is already listed. 'The messenger of YHWH' at 37:36 was ratified by the founder (sign-off 2026-11-27). The isaiah-woh commentary on 37:36 carries a separately labelled speculative reception note (founder sign-off 2026-11-27); the entry's claim is unchanged.

isaiah-woh wave I-6 (Isa 37:16): the fixed title yōšēḇ hakkᵉrūḇîm is rendered 'who is enthroned on the cherubim', the wording already printed at 2SA-WOH-6:2 (2-samuel-woh overlay yoshev-hakkeruvim-enthroned-on-the-cherubim-2-samuel-6-2), so the title has one English form in the corpus (accepted, founder sign-off 2026-11-27). ASV supplies '[above]', JPS 1917 'sittest upon', NJPS 'enthroned on the Cherubim' (checked 2026-11-27). The same title stands at 1 Sam 4:4; Ps 80:2; 99:1; 2 Kgs 19:15 (MT checked) and should take the same wording when those books are translated.

isaiah-woh wave I-6: Isa 37:11 lᵉhaḥărîmām 'devoting them to destruction', in the Assyrian king's message about what the kings of Assyria have done to all the lands; ASV and JPS 1917 'by destroying them utterly', NJPS 'how they have annihilated them' (checked 2026-11-27). The same in 2 Kgs 19:11 (MT, Sefaria, checked).

isaiah-woh wave I-6: Isa 37:16 ʾattāh ʿāśîṯā ʾeṯ-haššāmayim wᵉʾeṯ-hāʾāreṣ 'you have made the skies and the earth', the creation merism of Hezekiah's prayer, as Isa 42:5; 44:24; 45:18 ('the skies'); the same in 2 Kgs 19:15.

isaiah-woh wave I-6: Isa 37:25 kōl yᵉʾōrê māṣôr 'all the rivers of Egypt', plural yᵉʾōrîm with no nᵉhārôt beside it, so 'rivers' under the Isaiah clause (as 7:18); at 19:6 the same phrase is 'the streams of Egypt' because nᵉhārôt is 'rivers' in that verse. ASV and JPS 1917 'all the rivers of Egypt', NJPS 'All the streams of Egypt' (checked 2026-11-27).

isaiah-woh wave I-6: the Isa 37:26 site named above is now governed. wîṣartîhā 'and formed it' (ASV 'formed it of ancient times'), 'form' kept; JPS 1917 'fashioned', NJPS 'I designed it long ago' (checked 2026-11-27). The verse shares lᵉmērāḥôq / mērāḥôq with Isa 22:11, where the line also has 'formed'.

isaiah-woh wave I-6: Isa 37:4 haššᵉʾērîṯ hannimṣāʾāh 'the remnant that is left' (ASV, JPS 1917; NJPS 'the surviving remnant') and 37:32 kî mîrûšālaim tēṣēʾ šᵉʾērîṯ ûp̄ᵉlêṭāh mēhar ṣiyyôn 'For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and survivors out of Mount Zion' (checked 2026-11-27), the šᵉʾērîṯ + pᵉlêṭāh pair this entry and its sibling name. pᵉlêṭāh is 'survivors' in Isaiah (isaiah-woh 4:2; 10:20; 37:31-32), not the Gen 45:7 'deliverance'. The same in 2 Kgs 19:4, 31 (MT, Sefaria, checked).
